integrity: Proved analytical all-parameter covariance spectrum and strict weight optimum; finite exact-rational verification is corroborative only. Scientific review is same-model and no independent audit or independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The graph is precisely a two-clique one-vertex coalescence, with a positive constant edge weight on each clique and uniformly sampled distinct zonotope vertices. No general block-graph, volume-sampling, arbitrary within-clique weighting, or historical-priority claim is made. Known unweighted Laplacian spectra of the same graphs are expressly not claimed as new; an equivalent earlier weighted-spectral optimization could exist.
title: A unique covariance-conditioning optimum for weighted two-clique graphical zonotopes
